library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data from current directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# PCA
set.seed(42)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP
set.seed(42)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# DoubletFinder parameter sweep
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets (0.8% per 1000 cells)
nExp_poi <- round(0.008 * ncol(pbmc) * (ncol(pbmc)/1000))

# Estimate homotypic doublets
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the doublet classification column name
df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets on UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = df_col, cols = c("red", "gray"))

markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Save markers to a CSV
write.csv(markers, "pbmc_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Annotate clusters using known marker genes
# Define a simple annotation dictionary
annotation_dict <- list(
  "CD3D" = "T cells",
  "MS4A1" = "B cells",
  "GNLY" = "NK cells",
  "FCER1A" = "Dendritic cells",
  "PPBP" = "Platelets",
  "LYZ" = "Monocytes"
)

# Function to assign cell type based on top marker
assign_cell_type <- function(cluster_id, markers_df, dict) {
  top_genes <- markers_df %>% filter(cluster == cluster_id) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% head(10) %>% pull(gene)
  for (gene in top_genes) {
    if (gene %in% names(dict)) {
      return(dict[[gene]])
    }
  }
  return("Unknown")
}

# Apply annotation
cluster_ids <- unique(markers$cluster)
cluster_annotations <- sapply(cluster_ids, assign_cell_type, markers_df = markers, dict = annotation_dict)

# Add annotations to Seurat object metadata
pbmc$cell_type <- factor(cluster_annotations[as.character(pbmc$seurat_clusters)])

# Save updated Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, "pbmc_seurat_annotated.rds")

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load your PBMC dataset (replace with your actual data loading step)
# Example: pbmc <- readRDS("pbmc_seurat_object.rds")
pbmc <- readRDS("pbmc_seurat_object.rds")

# Ensure clusters are identified (if not, run clustering)
if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(pbmc@meta.data)) {
  pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
  pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
}

# Specify the two clusters of interest
cluster1 <- "0"
cluster2 <- "1"

# Subset cells belonging to the two clusters
cells_to_compare <- WhichCells(pbmc, idents = c(cluster1, cluster2))
pbmc_subset <- subset(pbmc, cells = cells_to_compare)

# Perform differential expression analysis
de_results <- FindMarkers(pbmc_subset, ident.1 = cluster1, ident.2 = cluster2, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Add gene names as a column
de_results$gene <- rownames(de_results)

# Visualize top differentially expressed genes with a violin plot
top_genes <- de_results %>% arrange(p_val_adj) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(gene)

# Violin plots for top genes
pbmc_subset %>%
  VlnPlot(features = top_genes, group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw()

# Alternatively, create a heatmap of top genes
top_genes_heatmap <- de_results %>% arrange(p_val_adj) %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% pull(gene)

DoHeatmap(pbmc_subset, features = top_genes_heatmap, group.by = "seurat_clusters") + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("navy", "white", "firebrick")) + 
  theme_minimal()
